doc.name: VENUS
doc.title: THE VEILED ONE
doc.blurb: The brightest thing in the night after the Moon, wrapped in a veil of sulphur cloud so thick no one saw its ground until radar did; it never twinkles, and its clouds race round in four days while the ground beneath takes 243. The attack is the veil flashing white. The eye is the south polar vortex, a storm with two eyes of its own.
doc.where: SS_ACTS[0].minis @243: append 'venus_world' (Act I mini; Wyatt confirms). 'venus' is the MENU SKY's point decor; this is the world.
